malformedInput.finding: declares image/png but is truncated: valid PNG signature then a length field that runs past EOF and no IHDR; the host refuses it as RECIPE_BINDING_ERROR before any provider call

conclusion: The same unchanged recipe and the same valid known image were executed through two independently configured live image-capable DSH provider routes; both identified the known red fill and neither invented text/shapes. The earlier contradictory white/orange output was produced from a MALFORMED 76-byte PNG; malformed bytes are now refused before inference (and were already refused by the broker binding validator).
